# Shield KYA features

> Generated from sdks/kya/features.json and replays/pages/pages.json by `pnpm sync:features`. Do not edit by hand. Lists the live open source
> CLI features. Hosted features: https://shield-agent.com/docs/kya/hosted-commands. Full table with docs links:
> https://docs.shield-agent.com/features.html

## Features

- Print version: Prints the installed kya version and exits. Command or flag: `kya version`, `--version`, `-v`, `-V`.
- One-line start: Shows a plan first (each file, created or merged, exact keys), asks once, then wires the local MCP gate into the coding hosts found on this machine and opens the live report in the background. It ends with a guard proof: three built-in demo calls go through the hook and are blocked, and they are not saved to the trail. Command or flag: `kya start`, `--no-open`, `--force`, `--no-gate`, `--yes`, `--dry-run`, `KYA_YES=1`.
- Undo kya start: Reads the manifest of every write, removes only the keys KYA added, deletes files KYA created if unchanged, restores merged files byte for byte, and prints what it left alone. Hook launcher in ~/.kya/bin fails open; kya doctor flags a dead path. Command or flag: `kya uninstall`, `--project`, `--dry-run`, `~/.kya/manifest.json`, `~/.kya/bin/kya-hook`.
- Stop report server: Stops the background report server that kya start began. Command or flag: `kya stop`, `--all`.
- Scaffold config: Creates the .kya config folder with sample tools and an env example. Command or flag: `kya init`, `--force`.
- Wire a coding host: Writes the KYA MCP server into the config of one coding host (12 hosts). Command or flag: `kya connect`, `--project`, `--force`.
- Wire PreToolUse hook: Writes the PreToolUse hook for claude, grok or kimi. With --project, the claude hook goes into the project's .claude/settings.json. Command or flag: `kya connect`, `--hooks`.
- Point host at gateway: Points a coding host at the local kya gateway. Command or flag: `kya connect`, `--gate`.
- Self-update and version banner: Updates kya to the latest npm version. kya start warns when a newer release exists. Command or flag: `kya update`, `--no-update-check`, `KYA_UPDATE_CHECK`.
- Node 22 check and handoff: Checks the Node version and hands off to a supported Node 22 or newer. Command or flag: none.
- Homebrew install: Installs kya with Homebrew from The-Pixel-Boys tap. Command or flag: `brew install The-Pixel-Boys/tap/shield-kya`.
- Scoop install: Installs kya on Windows with Scoop. Command or flag: `scoop install shield-kya`.
- Team rollout: commit plugin pin: Adds a tag-pinned plugin marketplace and an enabled plugin to the project settings for everyone who opens the repo. Command or flag: `kya team init`, `--dry-run`.
- Managed-settings JSON for admins: Prints the managed-settings JSON an administrator deploys. Command or flag: `kya team managed-settings`.
- Team rollout: guard plugin for a repository: Adds a tag-pinned plugin marketplace and the kya-guard plugin to the project settings, prints the exact diff and an agent-guarded README badge that links to the public scoreboard, and is reversed by kya uninstall --project. Command or flag: `--guard`.
- Repository policy file: Optional .kya/policy.json committed with the repo. Adds deny and requireApprove tool ids for the local gate; it cannot relax a verdict, and an invalid file is ignored with a note. Command or flag: `.kya/policy.json`.
- Opt-in usage stats: Anonymous usage stats, off by default. Status, on, off, show and reset. Command or flag: `kya telemetry`, `--purge`.
- Global activity record: Keeps a global activity log in the KYA home folder. Reports read the last 1 MB of it. Command or flag: `KYA_HOME`.
- Activity report: Writes the activity report as HTML, JSON or Markdown for the last few days or one session. The first panel is Blocked (the last five blocked calls, or a labelled demo before the first one); Certify has its own tab. Command or flag: `kya receipt`, `--open`, `--days`, `--session`, `--q`, `--json`, `--out`.
- Near-miss card: Makes a 1200 by 630 image (SVG, and PNG when a renderer is on the machine) about the last call the guard denied: the rule, the host and the date, nothing private. Prints a two-line caption. A button next to each stopped call in the live report, and the command in a saved report. Command or flag: `kya receipt`, `--card`.
- Redacted share link: Publishes a redacted summary of the report and prints a public link and a claim link. Command or flag: `kya receipt`, `--share`, `--share-url`, `--share-retries`, `KYA_SHARE_URL`.
- Share and claim: The live report has a Share this report button that makes the redacted public link, with a copy control. The shared page has a claim form: confirm an email address to keep the report and get one summary email each week. A claim never connects a computer: kya login does. Unclaimed links are deleted after 7 days. Command or flag: `kya start`, `kya receipt`, `--share`, `kya login`, `KYA_SHARE_URL`.
- Natural-language search in report: Search box in the activity report. Command or flag: none.
- Map of agent actions: Graph and heat views of what KYA recorded for agent actions on this machine. Local only. Advisory. Command or flag: `kya map`, `--days`, `--json`, `--html`, `--session`.
- Agent-flow export: Writes the local trail as an agent-flow JSONL event log. Classes only, no args. Local only. Advisory. Command or flag: `kya export`, `--format`, `--days`, `--session`, `--out`, `--force`.
- Redacted change previews: Shows clipped, redacted change previews on the report. Set KYA_DIFF_PREVIEW=0 to turn them off. Command or flag: `KYA_DIFF_PREVIEW`.
- Terminal desk: Terminal view with free panes. Actions work on a TTY; --once prints one frame for CI. Command or flag: `kya dash`, `--once`, `--pane`.
- IoC check: Scans this machine for known supply-chain indicators. Read-only and offline. Runs once a day in the background from kya hook and shows in kya doctor, kya dash and kya receipt. Command or flag: `kya doctor`, `kya doctor --iocs`, `--iocs`, `--json`, `KYA_IOC=0`, `ioc.enabled=false`.
- Developer posture report (opt-in): Off by default. kya posture on prints the exact report and asks; a send needs the local toggle, a hosted login and the workspace policy. Minimised fields only; the client refuses any report with an environment name or value, a path, a user or host name, or an IP address. Advisory. Command or flag: `kya posture`, `status`, `on`, `off`, `send`, `--dry-run`, `--json`, `label`, `--yes`.
- Cost showback: Observe-only cost showback inside the activity report. Command or flag: none.
- Never-list block: Blocks never-list tools in the PreToolUse hook. kya hook exits 2 on DENY. Command or flag: `kya hook`.
- Guard pack: Second layer of local denies in the PreToolUse hook, local and hosted (--plane-config): destructive shell commands, credential reads, secret-shaped writes and secret exfiltration. Four rules ask the person instead of denying (Claude Code permissionDecision ask; other hosts deny). Config and guardAllow come from the user-level ~/.kya/config.json only. Command or flag: `kya hook`.
- Advisory hook record: Records ALLOW and REQUIRE_APPROVE decisions in the hook. The call proceeds. Command or flag: `kya hook`.
- Strict hook mode: Strict mode denies advisory decisions in the hook. Command or flag: `kya hook`, `--strict`.
- Local MCP gate server: Serves the local MCP gate over HTTP, or over stdio for hosts. Command or flag: `kya serve-mcp`, `--stdio`, `--port`.
- Local MCP gateway: Governs and audits tool calls to any MCP server through a local gateway. Command or flag: `kya gate`, `kya gate init`, `kya gate setup`, `kya gate run`, `kya gate stop`, `kya gate status`, `kya gate doctor`.
- Destructive names and ADMIN tier denied: Gateway policy denies destructive tool names and the ADMIN tier. Command or flag: none.
- Auto-import of host MCP servers: kya start imports MCP servers found in host configs into the gateway. Turn off with --no-gate or KYA_GATE=off. Command or flag: `kya start`, `--no-gate`, `KYA_GATE`.
- Evaluate and record a command: Evaluates a command and records it in the trail. With --tool-id it never runs anything. With `-- <cmd>` it runs the command only when the verdict allows. Command or flag: `kya wrap`, `--offline`, `--hold`, `--json`, `--work-item`, `--tool-id`, `--irreversible`.
- Policy evaluate, exit codes: Evaluates a tool call against policy and exits with a code per verdict. Command or flag: `kya eval-tool`, `--offline`, `--tool-id`, `--irreversible`, `--args`, `--session-risk`, `--risk`, `--approval-status`, `--sandbox-id`.
- Read-only ORR board: Builds a read-only ORR board from producers and writes a report. It is not a second policy point. Command or flag: `kya orr run`, `--path`, `--producer`, `--out`, `--skip-optional-producers`, `--agentshield-json`, `--commit-sha`, `--name`, `--rubric`, `--disable-category`, `--usage`, `--scorecard`, `--quiet`, `--json-stdout`, `--fail-on`, `--format`.
- Trust baseline gap report: Lists gaps in the Agent Trust Baseline from local evidence. Command or flag: `kya certify`, `--window`, `--fail-on`, `--open`, `--json-stdout`, `--catalog`, `--out`, `--format`, `--quiet`.
- Local attestation: Records a local attestation for one requirement ID. Command or flag: `kya certify`, `--attest`, `--text`.
- Self-signed evidence bundle: Writes a self-signed evidence bundle. It shows integrity and key continuity, not identity. Command or flag: `kya certify`, `--sign`.
- EU AI Act mapping: Maps certify evidence to EU AI Act articles. Command or flag: none.
- Import foreign traces: Imports traces from other tools into the local trail so the report and certify can read them. Command or flag: `kya import`, `--from`, `--file`.
- Detections and fix briefs: Finds detections in the trail, groups them into incidents and writes fix briefs for coding agents. Command or flag: `kya investigate`, `--json`.
- Endpoint discovery: Scans this endpoint for AI agents, IDEs, runtimes and MCP servers. Command or flag: `kya discover`, `--json`, `--diff`, `--push`, `--file`.
- Opt-in Firecracker wrap: Opt-in sandbox that runs a command inside a Firecracker VM. Not an MCP tool. Command or flag: `kya sandbox`, `--sandbox`, `--sandbox-id`, `--cmd`, `--path`, `--offline`, `KYA_SANDBOX`.
- Alerts: Sends decision alerts and incident alerts to webhooks set in the config file, and shows a desktop notification for each new incident alert. Incident alerts are off by default. `kya start` offers them once; an optional local triage model is part of the offer. Command or flag: `kya alerts`, `kya alerts status`, `kya alerts test`, `kya alerts on`, `kya alerts off`, `--json`, `KYA_ALERTS=on`, `alerts.desktop`, `KYA_ALERTS_DESKTOP=off`.
- Local triage model for security alerts: Optional offline model (ModernBERT-base, int8 ONNX, about 150 MB) that adds category, urgency, next step and a benign score to each incident alert. Offered once by `kya start` (Turn on security alerts? [Y/n]). One sha256-pinned download. Advisory: it never removes an alert and never changes the severity. Command or flag: `KYA_ALERTS=on`, `KYA_ALERTS=off`, `KYA_TRIAGE_MODEL_PATH`.
- OTLP export: Exports metrics to an OpenTelemetry collector through the gateway OTLP receiver. Command or flag: `otlpPort`.
- OTLP map attributes: Adds the target class and the hashed device id to decision spans. Opt-in in the user-level config only. Default off. Command or flag: `otlpExport.mapAttrs`.
- In-process SDK shims: Adapters for in-process agent SDKs: Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, Mastra, OpenAI Agents and Vercel AI. Command or flag: none.
- Python framework shim: Python package shield-kya that gives agent frameworks the KYA checks. Command or flag: `pip install shield-kya`.
- Claude Code plugin: Claude Code plugin for kya, installed from the shield-kya marketplace. Command or flag: `/plugin install kya@shield-kya`.
- Codex plugin: Codex plugin for kya. Command or flag: `codex plugin add kya@shield-kya`.
- Copilot CLI plugin: Copilot CLI plugin for kya. Command or flag: `copilot plugin install kya@shield-kya`.
- Gemini CLI extension: Gemini CLI extension for kya. Command or flag: `gemini extensions install`.
- Cursor plugin: Cursor plugin manifest for kya. Command or flag: none.
- VS Code extension: VS Code extension for kya, published on the Visual Studio Marketplace. Command or flag: none.
- GitHub Action kya-certify: GitHub Action that runs kya certify in a workflow. Command or flag: `uses: The-Pixel-Boys/kya-action`.
- Org Hold: Holds a call for an org approval path instead of observing it. Command or flag: `KYA_HOLD`, `--hold`.
- Plane connection and keys: Connects the CLI to the hosted plane with an API key, a base URL, a host and an agent ID. Command or flag: `KYA_API_KEY`, `KYA_BASE_URL`, `KYA_HOST`, `--base-url`, `--api-key`, `--host`, `--agent-id`.
- Hosted login (device code): Links this machine to the hosted console with a device code. Saves a full-workspace key with mode 0600 in ~/.kya/hosted-credentials.json. Command or flag: `kya login`, `--base-url`.
- Sign out on this machine: Deletes the saved hosted key file on this machine. The key stays active on the server until revoked. Command or flag: `kya logout`.
- Share calls to action: One line, at most once a day, after kya certify (gaps), kya receipt, and kya start once the trail has 10 events. Every line asks for kya receipt --share. Silent in CI, non-TTY, KYA_QUIET, KYA_CTA=0 and config opt-out. Command or flag: `KYA_QUIET`, `KYA_CTA`.

## Replay pages

Each page rebuilds one dangerous agent call as a test, shows how to prevent it without any extra tool, and states whether KYA stops it. Hubs group the pages by vendor and by agent. Index: https://shield-agent.com/replays

- [Agent wipes a production database during a code freeze](https://shield-agent.com/replays/2025-07-replit-production-database): Agent wipes a production database during a code freeze. Postgres fix: give the agent a database role...
- [Stop an agent trying to delete a cloud volume](https://shield-agent.com/replays/2026-04-pocketos-railway-volume): Agent deletes a production volume and its backups through the Railway API. Railway fix: keep backups outside the Railway project.
- [AWS RDS instance deletion: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-aws-rds-delete-instance): AWS RDS instance deletion. AWS fix: turn on deletion protection for the instance...
- [AWS S3 bucket removal with force: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-aws-s3-remove-bucket): AWS S3 bucket removal with force. AWS fix: turn on S3 Versioning, so a delete leaves earlier versions that you can restore.
- [Stop an agent trying to delete Docker volumes](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-docker-volume-prune): docker volume prune with all and force. Docker fix: back up the data in named volumes to a place outside Docker.
- [Post the environment to a remote host with curl](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-exfil-curl): Post the environment to a remote host with curl. Network tools fix: turn on the Claude Code sandbox network allowlist.
- [Pipe the environment into netcat: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-exfil-nc): Pipe the environment into netcat. Network tools fix: turn on the Claude Code sandbox network allowlist.
- [Pipe the environment into ncat: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-exfil-ncat): Pipe the environment into ncat. Network tools fix: turn on the Claude Code sandbox network allowlist.
- [Copy the environment to a remote host with rsync](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-exfil-rsync): Copy the environment to a remote host with rsync. Network tools fix: turn on the Claude Code sandbox network allowlist.
- [Copy the environment to a remote host with scp](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-exfil-scp): Copy the environment to a remote host with scp. Network tools fix: turn on the Claude Code sandbox network allowlist.
- [Pipe the environment into socat: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-exfil-socat): Pipe the environment into socat. Network tools fix: turn on the Claude Code sandbox network allowlist.
- [Post the environment to a remote host with wget](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-exfil-wget): Post the environment to a remote host with wget. Network tools fix: turn on the Claude Code sandbox network allowlist.
- [Stop an agent trying to destroy a Fly app or volume](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-fly-volumes-destroy): Fly.io volume destroy. Fly.io fix: keep copies of the volume data outside Fly.
- [Google Cloud SQL instance deletion: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-gcloud-sql-delete-instance): Google Cloud SQL instance deletion. Google Cloud fix: turn on deletion protection for the Cloud SQL instance...
- [Stop an agent trying to delete a GitHub repository](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-gh-repo-delete): GitHub repository deletion. GitHub fix: give the agent a fine-grained token limited to the repositories it needs.
- [Stop an agent trying to delete the main branch](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-git-delete-default-branch): Delete the main branch on the remote. Git fix: protect the default branch on the server...
- [Stop an agent trying to force push over git history](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-git-force-push-branch): Force push to a feature branch. Git fix: add a branch ruleset on the server that blocks force pushes.
- [Stop an agent trying to force push over a protected branch](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-git-force-push-main): Force push to the main branch. Git fix: protect main on the server (a GitHub branch protection rule or ruleset).
- [Stop an agent trying to throw away all uncommitted work](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-git-hard-reset-clean): git reset --hard followed by git clean -fdx. Git fix: commit or stash before the agent starts.
- [Stop an agent trying to delete a Kubernetes namespace](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-kubectl-delete-namespace): kubectl delete of the production namespace. Kubernetes fix: namespaces are cluster-scoped, so do not bind the agent to a ClusterRole...
- [Stop an agent trying to drop a MongoDB database](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-mongo-drop-database): mongosh dropDatabase. MongoDB fix: give the agent a database user with the read role.
- [Stop an agent trying to push a schema change that can drop data](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-prisma-accept-data-loss): Prisma db push that accepts data loss. Prisma fix: run prisma migrate dev --create-only to write the migration file without applying it.
- [Stop an agent trying to reset your database](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-prisma-migrate-reset): Prisma migrate reset with force. Prisma fix: keep the production DATABASE_URL out of the agent environment.
- [Railway API volumeDelete mutation over curl: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-railway-api-volume-delete): Railway API volumeDelete mutation over curl. Railway fix: keep backups outside the Railway project.
- [Railway CLI volume delete: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-railway-cli-volume-delete): Railway CLI volume delete. Railway fix: keep backups outside the Railway project.
- [Stop an agent trying to flush every key on a Redis server](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-redis-flush-remote): redis-cli FLUSHALL against a URL. Redis fix: give the agent a Redis ACL user (Redis 6 or later) with only +@read.
- [Stop an agent trying to delete the git history of the project](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-rm-git-dir): rm -rf of the project .git folder. Git fix: push the repository to a remote often.
- [Stop an agent trying to wipe the project folder](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-rm-project-wipe): rm -rf of everything in the project folder. The file system fix: commit often and push, so git can bring back the committed state of tracked files.
- [Stop an agent trying to wipe the root folder](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-rm-unset-variable-root): rm -rf of a path that starts with an unset variable. The file system fix: in shell scripts, write ${VAR:?} before a deletion.
- [Read an Azure CLI token cache: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-read-azure): Read an Azure CLI token cache. Azure fix: add a deny rule such as Read(~/.azure/**) to the Claude Code settings.
- [Read the Docker registry credentials file: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-read-docker): Read the Docker registry credentials file. Docker fix: use a Docker credential helper (credsStore in ~/.docker/config.json, such as osxkeychain).
- [Dump the environment of a running process: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-read-environ): Dump the environment of a running process. Linux processes fix: run the agent as its own OS user: Linux lets only the same user.
- [Read tool opens a private key: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-read-file): Read tool opens a private key. SSH keys fix: add a deny rule such as Read(~/.ssh/**) to the Claude Code settings.
- [Read a gcloud config file: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-read-gcloud): Read a gcloud config file. Google Cloud fix: add a deny rule such as Read(~/.config/gcloud/**) to the Claude Code settings.
- [Read the GitHub CLI token file: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-read-gh): Read the GitHub CLI token file. GitHub fix: let gh keep its token in the system keyring and not in hosts.yml.
- [Read a private key kept outside ~/.ssh: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-read-key): Read a private key kept outside ~/.ssh. SSH keys fix: keep private keys out of the project folder: store a deploy key in the secret store of your CI...
- [Read the kubectl config with cluster credentials](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-read-kube): Read the kubectl config with cluster credentials. Kubernetes fix: give the agent its own kubeconfig...
- [Read the PyPI upload credentials file: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-read-pypirc): Read the PyPI upload credentials file. PyPI fix: publish from CI with PyPI Trusted Publishing.
- [Read the Railway CLI token file: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-read-railway): Read the Railway CLI token file. Railway fix: pass a project token in the environment of the one command that needs it.
- [Read a production .env file with cat: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-read-shell): Read a production .env file with cat. .env files fix: keep production secrets in the secret store of your host and only development values in .env files.
- [Write an AWS access key id into a deploy script](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-write-aws): Write an AWS access key id into a deploy script. AWS fix: use IAM roles or IAM Identity Center (aws sso login).
- [Write a GitHub token into a source file: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-write-github): Write a GitHub token into a source file. GitHub fix: read the token from an environment variable or a secret store at run time.
- [Write a fine-grained GitHub token into a CI file](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-write-github-pat): Write a fine-grained GitHub token into a CI file. GitHub fix: in GitHub Actions, use the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN with a permissions block.
- [Write a private key into the repo: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-write-privkey): Write a private key into the repo. SSH keys fix: keep private keys out of the repository: use ssh-agent.
- [Write a Slack bot token into a config file: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-write-slack): Write a Slack bot token into a config file. Slack fix: read the Slack token from an environment variable or a secret store.
- [Write a Stripe live key into a shell profile: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-secret-write-stripe): Write a Stripe live key into a shell profile. Stripe fix: use a restricted API key (rk_live_) that has only the permissions the script needs.
- [Stop an agent trying to delete every row in a table](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-sql-delete-all): DELETE FROM a table with no WHERE clause. Postgres fix: give the agent a role that has no DELETE privilege on production tables and does not own them.
- [TRUNCATE TABLE with CASCADE: how to stop it](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-sql-truncate-cascade): TRUNCATE TABLE with CASCADE. Postgres fix: do not grant the TRUNCATE privilege to the agent's role.
- [Stop an agent trying to wipe a linked Supabase database](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-supabase-reset-linked): Supabase db reset on the linked remote project. Supabase fix: link the agent only to a staging project.
- [Stop an agent trying to destroy your infrastructure](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-terraform-destroy): Terraform destroy with auto approve. Terraform fix: set lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true } on the resources you cannot lose.
- [Stop an agent trying to remove a Vercel project](https://shield-agent.com/replays/class-vercel-remove-project): Vercel project removal. Vercel fix: use a Vercel access token for the one team the agent works in.
- [Coding agent risks with AWS: replays and fixes](https://shield-agent.com/replays/vendor/aws): 3 coding-agent replays involving AWS: what happens, the fix without any extra tool, and the Shield KYA replay result.
- [Coding agent risks with Docker: replays and fixes](https://shield-agent.com/replays/vendor/docker): 2 coding-agent replays involving Docker: what happens, the fix without any extra tool, and the Shield KYA replay result.
- [Coding agent risks with the file system: replays and fixes](https://shield-agent.com/replays/vendor/filesystem): 2 coding-agent replays involving the file system: what happens, the fix without any extra tool, and the Shield KYA replay result.
- [Coding agent risks with Google Cloud: replays and fixes](https://shield-agent.com/replays/vendor/gcloud): 2 coding-agent replays involving Google Cloud: what happens, the fix without any extra tool, and the Shield KYA replay result.
- [Coding agent risks with Git: replays and fixes](https://shield-agent.com/replays/vendor/git): 5 coding-agent replays involving Git: what happens, the fix without any extra tool, and the Shield KYA replay result.
- [Coding agent risks with GitHub: replays and fixes](https://shield-agent.com/replays/vendor/github): 4 coding-agent replays involving GitHub: what happens, the fix without any extra tool, and the Shield KYA replay result.
- [Coding agent risks with Kubernetes: replays and fixes](https://shield-agent.com/replays/vendor/kubernetes): 2 coding-agent replays involving Kubernetes: what happens, the fix without any extra tool, and the Shield KYA replay result.
- [Coding agent risks with network tools: replays and fixes](https://shield-agent.com/replays/vendor/network): 7 coding-agent replays involving network tools: what happens, the fix without any extra tool, and the Shield KYA replay result.
- [Coding agent risks with Postgres: replays and fixes](https://shield-agent.com/replays/vendor/postgres): 3 coding-agent replays involving Postgres: what happens, the fix without any extra tool, and the Shield KYA replay result.
- [Coding agent risks with Prisma: replays and fixes](https://shield-agent.com/replays/vendor/prisma): 2 coding-agent replays involving Prisma: what happens, the fix without any extra tool, and the Shield KYA replay result.
- [Coding agent risks with Railway: replays and fixes](https://shield-agent.com/replays/vendor/railway): 4 coding-agent replays involving Railway: what happens, the fix without any extra tool, and the Shield KYA replay result.
- [Coding agent risks with SSH keys: replays and fixes](https://shield-agent.com/replays/vendor/ssh): 3 coding-agent replays involving SSH keys: what happens, the fix without any extra tool, and the Shield KYA replay result.
- [Claude Code: which KYA replays were tested](https://shield-agent.com/replays/agent/claude): Which Shield KYA replays ran on Claude Code, and what the Claude Code setup page says KYA can and cannot see.
